description:
We’re EarthEnvi—and we make feeling good feel... actually good. No crash, no caffeine sweats, no pretending your fourth cold brew counts as breakfast.

Our Luxe Gummies are for the socially ambitious: the ones who want to show up, stand out, and not burn out. Packed with Kava and other botanicals, they help you vibe better, talk smoother, and maybe even remember your Wi-Fi password.

Founded by Bronson Bonner (yep—Air Force vet, environmental scientist, and low-key wizard), we mix nature and neuroscience to make plant-powered magic. And our ingredients? Responsibly sourced. Because guilt trips don’t belong in your wellness routine.

And yeah—every order supports reforestation and veteran charities. So when you collab with us, you’re not just selling gummies. You’re boosting moods, planting trees, and helping heroes. All while looking cool and getting paid.

🚀 Introducing The 20/5 Club System

We’ve upgraded our program to reward you not just for what you sell—but for who you bring with you.

Tier 1: Earn 20% commission on every sale made through your unique link.

Tier 2: Bring another affiliate into the squad? You’ll earn 5% of everything they sell, for life.
No limits. No fluff. Just smart stacking that lets your influence do the heavy lifting.

This is how impact scales. It’s how smart creators earn more without doing more.

Basically: You spread the word. We bring the botanicals. Everyone wins—especially your followers.
